description: Resolve a street address or assessor parcel number to the lot itself, from Los Angeles, San Diego, Sacramento or Riverside County records: APN, the agency that issues its permits, lot area, the footprint of each existing structure, and the area left for a new unit after the state-minimum setbacks and separation from existing buildings. Use before answering "can I build an ADU here" and before match_plans_to_lot. Coverage is Los Angeles, San Diego, Sacramento and Riverside counties only. Example: {"address": "12237 Wendy Dr, Cerritos, CA 90703"}.

address.description: Street address with city; ZIP helps. Example: "12237 Wendy Dr, Cerritos, CA 90703".

apn.description: Assessor parcel number, punctuated as the county prints it (7056-012-013 in Los Angeles, 639-660-14-00 in San Diego, 269-0203-005-0000 in Sacramento, 779-250-015 in Riverside).

county.description: Force the county: la (Los Angeles), sd (San Diego), sac (Sacramento) or riv (Riverside). Usually inferred from the address.

name: resolve_parcel
title: Look up a lot
